task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from a full S3 URI (e.g., 's3://my-bucket-name/path/to/object')
solution_criteria: A regex pattern that extracts only the bucket name from various S3 URI formats, handling both virtual-hosted-style and path-style URIs

task: Create a JSON CloudFormation template snippet that defines an AWS Lambda execution role with basic S3 read permissions
solution_criteria: A valid JSON object containing an IAM role definition with Trust Policy and an inline policy granting s3:GetObject permissions

task: Write a Python function that validates an AWS IAM policy ARN format and returns True if valid, False otherwise
solution_criteria: A function that correctly identifies valid ARN formats (arn:aws:iam::account-id:role/role-name) and rejects malformed inputs
